title: Google has joined Amazon in attacking Nvidia’s stronghold with AI app developers
slides: Why is Nvidia's moat suddenly cracking?
Google now targets AI app developers with custom chips
Its TPUs undercut Nvidia on price for training
Your cloud bill could shift if you test alternatives
Pick one workload and benchmark it this week
thread_text:
1. Nvidia's Moat Is Cracking

Google's custom TPUs are now priced below Nvidia for AI training. That's a direct threat to the default assumption that Nvidia is the only game in town.

2. Custom Chips Target Developers

Google is pitching its TPUs specifically at AI app developers, not just its own internal teams. That opens a second supply lane for startups building on tight budgets.

3. Cheaper Training, Real Numbers

Google's TPUs undercut Nvidia on price for training workloads. The savings aren't theoretical—they hit cloud bills for anyone willing to switch.

4. Your Cloud Bill Could Shift

Testing an alternative doesn't mean a full migration. A single benchmark on one workload can reveal whether the price gap is real for your stack.

5. Benchmark One Workload Now

Pick one training job you run today and price it on a TPU instance this week. If you haven't compared, you don't know what you're overpaying.
